text:
marie: FYI -- Acme (acct: acme-inc) opened a support ticket — they started getting 429s from /v1/rerank this morning ~08:30 PST. Customer says traffic hasn't changed on their side. Error body: {"error":"quota_exceeded","message":"Rerank rate limit"}. They attached a few example responses and a request id: rnk-7f3a.

ben: Do we have the response headers? Need X-RateLimit-* and Retry-After to see which limiter hit. Also: how many candidates per request? Rerank accounting is per-candidate + per-request.

lisa: Rerank billing/limits are per-request and per-candidate. If they send large candidate lists repeatedly, they burn quota fast. Ask for full headers and a sample payload.

marie: Headers pasted by customer: X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1767205380
Retry-After: 30
x-request-id: rnk-7f3a
Their typical traffic: ~50 requests/sec, ~64 candidates each during peak window. They say they previously ran at this rate for months with no issues.

tomas: Quick math: 50 req/s * 60s = 3000 req/min. Their plan limit is 1200 req/min -> consistent with quota exhaustion. This will throw 429s as soon as Remaining hits 0. Also we have per-route concurrency protections that may synthesize extra 429s if queues back up.

infra-oncall: Can reproduce pattern in our load simulator with similar QPS and candidate counts — we get 429s and Retry-After headers. Confirmed the limiter triggered, not an auth or billing break.

marie: Customer is upset because they claim we silently changed limits. They want immediate mitigation. CS asked for temporary bump while they rework client.

ben: Short-term options:
- Temporary per-account quota increase (ops/billing approval required).
- Client-side throttling + exponential backoff on 429s (recommended).
- Reduce candidate_count per request (we recommend <= 20 for predictable QPS).
- Move to Dedicated capacity for guaranteed throughput.

lisa: Also add SDK-level guards: surface X-RateLimit-* headers and automatic jittered backoff on rerank calls. I'll file a ticket.

marie: For reproducibility I shared this script with them. They ran it and see identical 429s. Example repro (from customer):

```bash
for i in {1..1000}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"query":"best printer","candidates":["a","b","c", ... repeated 64 items ...]}' &
  sleep 0.02
done
```

They are effectively pushing ~50 req/s with large candidate arrays.

tomas: Ops note: when a customer bursts like this, we can see two risk vectors — quota exhaust and queue backpressure. The latter can present additional 429-like responses from protective middleware. Both are mitigated by throttling or Dedicated.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-01-RERANK-ACME, severity: P2, owner: infra-oncall.

cs_jordan: CS has asked for a 48-hour temporary quota bump while Acme implements client-side limits. Please advise process & ETA.

infra-oncall: I can apply a one-off quota increase for acct acme-inc for 24-48h. Will coordinate w/ billing for extension. Applied change at 1767205320 — monitor X-RateLimit-Remaining.

ben: Long-term: add clearer docs about per-candidate accounting, add dashboard spike alerts for rerank QPS, and offer a recommended client pattern (throttle + reduce batch size). Logged feature tickets: RD-4623 (SDK headers/backoff), RD-4624 (docs), RD-4625 (per-account quota dashboard).

lisa: Also found a minor bug: if candidate_count > 100 and a request fails our precheck, the error message returned was generic. I'll patch to return explicit guidance ("reduce candidate_count or request quota increase").

marie: CS updated Acme: temporary bump in place, suggested immediate changes (throttle to 20 req/s or reduce to 20 candidates). Customer agreed to deploy client fix today. I’ll close when they confirm backoff behavior.

tomas: Follow-up action items:
- infra: monitor acme-inc X-RateLimit metrics for 48h.
- eng-ml: prioritize clearer error messages and SDK backoff.
- product: review Dedicated upsell flow for high-rerank users.

marie: Adding label :lock: escalation and will post final status once billing confirms extension or they move to Dedicated.

(automated note) rate-limit-bot: Observed spike from acct acme-inc at 1767205145, throttle applied.
